prayerExcerpt.en-US: I desired nothing but a cell, and a cell they have given me.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Eu não desejava senão uma cela, e uma cela me deram.

meta.face: An Abruzzese of about eighty, CLEAN-SHAVEN as in the old fresco, with a pale, weathered, finely wrinkled complexion and a LONG, NARROW, STRAIGHT-SIDED face — a very HIGH forehead, cheekbones barely marked, the cheeks falling flat and parallel to a NARROW, rounded chin; a LONG, STRAIGHT, narrow nose; SMALL, LEVEL, almond-shaped grey eyes set CLOSE together under straight, sparse white brows; a LONG upper lip over a SMALL, gently pursed mouth; thin white hair in a monastic ring; the gaze calm and withdrawn, lowered to the book.
meta.basis: Wikipedia's lead image, Niccolò di Tommaso's fourteenth-century triptych panel, shows him enthroned in the tiara with a long, narrow, clean-shaven face, a long, straight nose and small, level eyes; the card keeps that face. The book tells his visions as a child, his mountain solitude, the rule that founded the Celestines, his election and resignation after four months, and his boarded cell under guard, where he died singing Lauds; its engraving shows a hooded hermit in a cave cell with a cross and a road below. Wikipedia names his cave on Monte Morrone above Sulmona and his death at about eighty-one.
